latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: The skill has been refocused to provide honest, targeted resume optimization for Chinese job seekers based on specific job descriptions (JD).

- Removed all ATS/PDF export/code generation features and related reference files.
- Skill scope now centers on: JD-based resume parsing, match evaluation, and suggestion generation in Chinese (including STAR framework rewriting).
- Added strict ethical guidelines: never fabricate experience, always clearly flag suggestions that need user confirmation, and provide honest gap analysis/learning paths.
- New detailed workflow covers resume parsing, JD analysis, matching score, keyword/skills optimization, reformulation per STAR, and gap-adjusted career advice.
- All outputs and examples have been localized and expanded for Chinese users, emphasizing responsible optimization and real-world interview risks.
- Extensive documentation replacing old file set, with numerous practical case examples and clear, actionable formatting for optimized feedback.
